params.memo: Optional repayment reference (invoice ID, loan ref) — attached via Arc Memo.

supplyAndBorrow(address,uint256,address,.details: Caller must have approved `collateralAsset` to this router (or use permit2Supply).

MEMO_CONTRACT().notice: Arc Memo contract (same address on both networks).

estimateGasCostUsdc(uint256).notice: Estimate USD cost of a pool action at current base fee.         On Arc gas is paid in USDC (native, 18 decimals).         gasUnits: estimated gas for the action (from off-chain simulation).         Returns cost in 1e6 USDC units (matching ERC-20 USDC decimals).

permit2Repay(address,uint256,uint256,uin.notice: Use a Permit2 signature to transfer `amount` then repay debt.         Attaches `memo` to the repayment via Arc Memo contract.

permit2Supply(address,uint256,uint256,ui.notice: Use a Permit2 signature to transfer `amount` of `asset` then supply to pool.         Eliminates a separate approve() transaction.

repayAllAndClose(address,uint256,address.notice: Repay full debt and withdraw all collateral in one call.         Caller must approve `debtAsset` to this contract for `maxDebtAmount` (use type(uint256).max).

repayAndWithdraw(address,uint256,address.notice: Atomically: pull debt token from caller → repay → withdraw collateral to caller.

supplyAndBorrow(address,uint256,address,.notice: Atomically: pull collateral from caller → supply → borrow `borrowAmount`         of `borrowAsset` to caller.
